chose: The reach for server#1091 ends at rung 3, building only the gap on rung-2 algorithms. The graph is server#1066's closed Stage (vertex kinds) and Waiter (edge kinds) enums. Each Waiter gains a want record, stage_want, written and cleared by the waiter's own pass. Urgency is a closed enum set only at roots (the owner's fast-track, server#1090, and an essay the owner is waiting to watch), inherited transitively along stage_want by a recursive CTE taking the max over waiters, and read by each stage's queue as the leading ORDER BY term; within a constellation the serialized blocker goes first (critical-path rank, HLFET / Airflow's downstream rule), then each stage's own order. How much runs at once stays with the lane and its give. A deadline as a root is left out: home-compute's 'no clock' invariant keeps time from deciding home's work. What is ours: which of home's pipelines wait on which, and which roots the owner cares about now; no tool knows either.
options: Rung 1: a workflow engine on home (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Temporal); rejected: it replaces every worker with an always-on service against the one-batch lane, its weights are static per DAG, and our dependencies are discovered from content, not declared

Rung 2: a scheduler library; rejected as a dependency, since the algorithm is a few lines of SQL over a table we must write anyway; its ideas (HLFET, Airflow's downstream rule, Bazel's Skyframe and Nix's demand-driven evaluation) are folded in
A per-case column for server#1090's fast-track read only by the transcriber; rejected as the granular case of this family (C830)
OS priority inheritance along one edge (PTHREAD_PRIO_INHERIT); kept as the propagation rule, not the whole design
Deriving wants with JSON1 over essay bodies inside the transcriber's query; rejected: it couples the queue to every waiter's format and rescans every body each pass
gray: Three boundaries no check settles: the render worker orders jobs in bash, so urgency reaches it only through an order file_host writes (C1015); Rust and interview essays wait on the transcriber through the cloud routine and the mailbox, off home; and chains are at most two deep today, so the CTE is bounded by the urgent roots' rows.
undo: Drop stage_want and its stores entry, and remove the urgency term from each stage's ORDER BY; the stages' own orders stand.
